name: Cortado MkIII
metaDescription: Cortado MkIII professional contact microphone — balanced XLR output, switchable pad and bass boost, 23Hz–40kHz response. Built for studio, field, and live sound.
description: The Cortado MkIII is a robust and versatile contact microphone that reveals the hidden sounds in the solid world around you. The Cortado's active circuitry delivers a balanced signal with wide bandwidth and flat frequency response which can be driven over very long cable runs with no signal degradation.
targetUse: Professional and home recording studios, field recording, sound design, live sound reinforcement
features: Built-in preamp circuit capable of driving a balanced signal through hundreds of feet of cable
Hand-matched, high quality components for a low noise floor and tonal transparency
Switchable Bass Boost enables bandwidth from 23Hz to 40kHz
-10dB switchable pad for loud sound sources
Sensor encased in an extremely robust metal enclosure
6 foot (1.8m) high quality shielded cable from chassis to sensor
Circuit enclosed in 20 gauge steel chassis for electrical shielding and rugged durability
Requires phantom power from a standard XLR mic cable
